title: Robo Mosaic
author: bestof-games
selftext: Do you think a hyper casual game like this can be successful?

comments.author: Tiny_Flatworm4726
comments.body: Yeah it can, but odds are essentially zero - looks pretty good, doesn't even look ai

comments.author: siendo64
comments.body: Looks neat. Mobile is a tough market. But when you’re ready to test it out and launch out some money into some ads and see how long people stick with it.

replies.author: bestof-games
replies.body:
Thank you very much, I am glad you like it 😊 if you have iOS and would like to test it, here is the TestFlight invite. I appreciate any feedback.
